name: Dustfire Valley
summary: At Searing Gorge’s northern edge, Dustfire Valley ends at the locked gate of Stonewrought Pass and the road to Loch Modan.

sections.title: The Northern Boundary
sections.body: Ash lies across the rock in Dustfire Valley, where bare canyon walls rise around you. At its northern end, a locked dwarven gate seals Stonewrought Pass. The doors bar direct travel to the Valley of Kings and Loch Modan, leaving the valley a dead end amid Searing Gorge’s sulfurous wastes.

faq.q: Where does the gate in Dustfire Valley lead?
faq.answer: The gate seals Stonewrought Pass, a mountain passage through the heights to the Valley of Kings in Loch Modan.

faq.q: Can you open the gate to Loch Modan?
faq.answer: The dwarven gate is locked to protect Loch Modan from threats in Searing Gorge. A specific key is needed to pass through.

faq.q: Why is this area called Dustfire Valley?
faq.answer: Dustfire Valley takes its name from the volcanic ash, dry dust, and lingering heat in the canyon near the northern mountain walls.

angles.text: As a dwarf, you know this heavily fortified gate marks a back door between the safety of Khaz Modan and territory ruled by the Dark Iron clan.
